tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: Within 120 days after the close of each calendar year, the Secretary of Transportation and the Secretary of Commerce each shall provide the Secretary of the Treasury a written report on the capital construction funds under the particular Secretary’s jurisdiction for the calendar year.

tree.heading: Contents.—
tree.text: The report shall state the name and taxpayer identification number of each person—

children.text: establishing a capital construction fund during the calendar year;
maintaining a capital construction fund on the last day of the calendar year;
terminating a capital construction fund during the calendar year;
making a deposit to or withdrawal from a capital construction fund during the calendar year, and the amount of the deposit or withdrawal; or
having been determined during the calendar year to have failed to fulfill a substantial obligation under a capital construction fund agreement to which the person is a party.
